incidents.class_reason: 1 holds: the task count was corrected to 16 at P6 before the report was finalized. 2 fails: codex-1's P5 count claim was made having received only P1, so it had not received codex-2's conflicting P4 count; P4 said 14 analytic tasks, P5 said 15 task records, while the YAML has 16 task records.
incidents.cause: Both agents posted counts before reconciling the complete YAML; codex-2 inspected a partial range before P4, and codex-1 posted its count without receiving P4.
incidents.consequence: The team briefly circulated conflicting task counts and corrected the count before finalizing the report; no required deliverable was left wrong.
incidents.severity_reason: 1: the count discrepancy was corrected at P6, within the next exchange, and no deliverable was lost or left incorrect.

incidents.class_reason: 1 holds: the task-3 distinction was stated on the board in P9. 2 holds: codex-1 had received P9 by P12. 3 fails: P9 says the task 3–4 potential matrices are correct and the offset is handled separately; P12 instead says the task-3 answer omitted the offset. P13 repeats that characterization, and P14 corrects it.
incidents.cause: Codex-1 inverted codex-2's task-3 finding while editing the report; codex-2 then endorsed the mistaken wording in its review.
incidents.consequence: The report temporarily described a correct staged potential answer as erroneous, requiring a correction before completion.
incidents.severity_reason: 2: correcting the mistaken report claim required additional editing and review; the final workspace report contains the correction.

incidents.class_reason: 1 holds: codex-2 had posted review findings on the board. 2 holds: codex-1 had received P13 and P14 by P15. 3 holds: P14 explicitly says the revised artifact still needs codex-2's confirmation. 4 holds: the posts make the pending review clear. 5 holds: the report and check existed in the workspace. 6 fails: codex-1 declared DONE while codex-2 was still checking and attempting to post its final review; P13 reviewed the version before P14's report correction.
incidents.cause: Codex-1 declared completion before receiving confirmation that codex-2 had reviewed the P14 report revision; the DONE post ended the run and cut codex-2's turn.
incidents.consequence: The final report revision was not independently reviewed on the board before completion, although the required files and passing check were present.
incidents.severity_reason: 4: the required report was left without independent review of its final revision because the run closed while that review was still underway.
